column1: # The JavaScript runtime-oracle subjects — the DEFINITION, not a description of one.
# A subject qualifies only if it brings its OWN test suite. The suite is the driver:
# a workload written for this measurement, by someone who had already seen the
# engine's output, would be measuring the author rather than the program.
#   name  set  commit  test  note
# `test` is the command run inside the instrumented mirror. `note` is last and may
# contain spaces.
# dev      designed against. A rule may be derived from what these projects show.
# holdout  DESIGN-BLIND. Measured, never used to derive a rule. When it surfaces a
#          defect class, the shape is reproduced under cases/ and the rule designed
#          from that, never from the held-out site itself.
# ── THE INTEGRITY CHECK IS PART OF THE MEASUREMENT ──────────────────────────
# The instrumented suite must produce the SAME pass/fail counts as the untouched
# one. A rewrite that changes what the program does is measuring a different
# program, and the failure mode is silent: the trace still looks complete. The
# baseline counts are recorded here so a drift is visible rather than inferred.
# $JS_RUNTIME, defaulting to ~/.cache/axiom-js-runtime. Deliberately NOT /tmp: the
# TypeScript corpus was kept there and the system reaper removed every source file
# from all nine projects mid-session.
# ── name    set      commit   test              note

axios       dev      56a5f1a  npx vitest run    1075 tests, 1 failed, instrumented and not. 13,975 sites, 3,230 executed, 896 of them production. ESM, "type": "module", and the suite drives node and fetch adapters both
